agents.name: swarm_agent_1
responsibilities: Admit durable user inputs and run provider turns through an OpenCode-derived session engine
Route Kimi API, Kimi Code, and compatible providers through one typed provider boundary
Execute file, shell, web, MCP, browser, and computer-use tools through one permission and receipt protocol
Coordinate Explore, Plan, Implement, Test, Review, Debug, Browser, and Research workers with a dependency graph
Create isolated Worktrees for independent implementation work and inherit them for validation and debugging
Persist session history, tool intents, receipts, artifacts, usage, and recovery checkpoints locally
Expose structured activity, approvals, diffs, terminal output, browser artifacts, and final answers in the desktop UI
Manage Skills, Hooks, MCP servers, and Plugins with capability discovery, isolation, health checks, and recovery
Enforce local security boundaries for filesystem, shell, network, credentials, and destructive Git actions
Measure per-stage token usage, latency, quality, retries, and cost budgets

risks.mitigation: Implement robust error handling and fallbacks

success_criteria: Validate tool schema and resource boundaries before permission prompts
Persist intent before any side effect and receipt after settlement
Never replay a successful receipt or automatically replay unknown writes
Reject writes outside the active Worktree
Allow public read-only web research by task or domain while blocking private targets
Keep secrets in Keychain or an encrypted local vault and redact logs
Require explicit approval for shell, destructive Git, Browser writes, and Computer Use
Maintain auditable event history and explicit user-driven recovery
